nodes.summary: Let $R = 5.69693$, let $\log$ be the natural logarithm, and let $\vartheta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ (over primes $p$) and $\psi(x) = \sum_{n \le x} \Lambda(n)$, with $\Lambda$ the von Mangoldt function, be Chebyshev's functions. nodes.title: Dusart's bound for $\vartheta$ and $\psi$ from a zero-free region

nodes.summary: Let $\theta(x) = \sum_{p \le x} \log p$ be the sum of $\log p$ over the primes $p \le x$. For every real $\varepsilon > 0$, $\theta(x) - x = O(x \exp(-(\log x)^{3/5 - \varepsilon}))$ as $x \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Prime number theorem with error term for Chebyshev's $\theta$
